info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizdoc-List Parking Reservations Permits-v4-spec
info.description: The Parking Reservations API enables users to efficiently manage and retrieve information regarding parking permits and reservations. This endpoint allows consumers to access a list of existing parking reservations, facilitating operational planning for both individual users and businesses. Typical use cases include verifying reservation details, checking permit statuses, and managing parking availability. With this API, developers can integrate parking data into applications, enhancing user experiences related to parking management.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to retrieve detailed information about reservation permits, including their current status and any associated data. It's designed to provide the necessary insights for effective management of permits within the reservation system.

requestBody.description: A request body containing the necessary information to retrieve reservation permits. It specifies the criteria for fetching the relevant permit data. Ensure that the data conforms to the required schema.
